info.title: webphone machine API
info.description: Generated from the handler wire types (go-cqrs-lite/catalog). The webhook lanes under /hooks/ and the /events SSE stream are machine-to-machine contracts documented separately (docs/contracts/).

post.description: Journal one finished call on the CRM contact that owns the number (no-op when the CRM is disabled or the number matches no contact — the integration never creates contacts).

204.description: No response body. Logged, or deliberately dropped (CRM disabled, or the number matches no CRM contact).

400.description: Malformed body, or direction not in/out.

429.description: Per-client write flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

502.description: The CRM could not record the call (unreachable or 5xx) — the island toasts.

post.description: Record the operator's post-call verdict for one call — the one authority that may claim answered (the island's auto-report only ever claims missed or unknown). Persists the verdict first, then journals the correction upstream; a CRM 502 leaves the verdict stored and the retry open. Same verdict again is an inert 204; a different verdict is a correction and journals again.

204.description: No response body. Verdict recorded (and corrected upstream, or deliberately not: CRM disabled, number matches no contact).

400.description: Malformed call id, body, disposition not in the vocabulary, or direction not in/out.

409.description: The extension's review-slot list is at its cap — delete another note first.

429.description: Per-client write flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

502.description: The CRM could not record the correction (unreachable or 5xx) — the verdict stays stored; the island offers a retry.

get.description: Read the signed-in extension's freeform note for one call. Always 200: an absent note is the empty body — the History form renders the same box either way.

429.description: Per-client read flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The call's island Call-ID (the transcript's key).

put.description: Upsert the signed-in extension's freeform note for one call (the slot is the owner+call pair — no duplicates). An empty body clears the note. A full note list is a 409: hand-written content is never silently expunged.

409.description: The extension's note list is at its cap — delete another note first.

429.description: Per-client write flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

post.description: Ask for the same AI follow-up draft the manual summarize button drafts, as a detached job — the island fires it once when a media call settles. The job runs without the request (closing the tab cannot abort it) and shares the summarize idempotency key, so exactly one of the two ever drafts; failure stays retryable because the key records successes only.

202.description: The job was accepted (duplicate:true when this call already has one — done or in flight).

404.description: The textagent seam is not configured, or the call has no transcript for this extension.

429.description: Per-client write flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

get.description: Read the signed-in extension's stored automatic review for one call — the durable record of what the AI made of it (pending while the job runs, present with the draft dims, failed on a refusal/outage). An absent review is the empty body.

200.description: The stored review (the empty body when none exists).

404.description: The textagent seam is not configured.

429.description: Per-client read flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The call's island Call-ID (the transcript's key).

post.description: Turn one call's stored transcript into an AI follow-up draft in the review queue (the Messages drafts panel reviews it). Idempotent within the window: a replay answers duplicate:true.

200.description: The drafted follow-up (or duplicate:true when this call was already summarized in the idempotency window).

404.description: The textagent seam is not configured, or the call has no transcript for this extension.

429.description: Per-client write flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

502.description: The AI agent is unreachable — the island toasts.

503.description: Transcript storage unavailable (or the agent answered 5xx).

post.description: Upsert one personal contact: a repeated number renames. Mutations answer 204 and the island re-fetches the list.

204.description: No response body. Saved (upsert by number within the session's extension).

422.description: Number failed dialable validation, or the per-extension list is full (500; renames never count).

429.description: Per-client write flood budget exhausted (generous: the legacy import bursts one POST per row); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

get.description: The session extension's personal contacts plus the configured shared ones. The LIST is the only drift-free id source (renames keep the old id).

200.description: Personal (store-backed, per extension) and shared (config) contacts.

delete.description: Delete one personal contact by id, scoped to the session's extension.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Contact id from the LIST response.

get.description: Fetch the fresh masked CSRF token after the login rotation invalidated the old one. Needs no session; the answer pairs with the csrf_token cookie and is no-store.

429.description: Per-client flood budget exhausted; the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

post.description: Advisory pre-invite cooldown check for one remote: allowed=true records the attempt and the invite may go out; allowed=false answers inside the cooldown window with the slot's last-at stamp and window length (nothing recorded — a retry loop must not extend the window it fights). A one-shot override (the click-through) arms before the attempt and is spent by the first allowed dial.

200.description: The verdict (allowed true or false; both are success answers).

400.description: Malformed body or remote (empty, over 64 chars, or containing / or %).

404.description: The dial cooldown is not configured (the gate is off — the island dials straight away).

429.description: Per-client write flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

502.description: Window store failure — the island dials anyway (the gate is advisory; a phone must dial).

get.description: The signed-in extension's ACTIVE cooldown windows, newest first — the dial typeahead decorates matching contact rows with the remaining wait instead of state nobody can see. Expired windows are skipped lazily; the POST's attempt path is what records and replaces rows.

200.description: The active windows (empty slots array when none are live).

404.description: The dial cooldown is not configured (the gate is off — nothing to decorate).

429.description: Per-client read flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

502.description: Window store scan failure — the island hides the decoration, it never blocks a dial.

post.description: Accept one fire-and-forget island latency measurement (the measure-first latency design): dial-press to first remote audio, or an ASR segment to text on screen, split into the server-fixed named legs. Pure instrumentation: every malformed beacon is a silent 204 — the endpoint never validates loudly, never retries, never alerts.

204.description: No response body. The beacon was folded into the /metrics histograms, or silently dropped (unknown interval, junk legs, malformed body — all the same 204 by design).

404.description: The beacon intake is not enabled on this server (metrics.island_beacon is off) — the surface does not exist.

413.description: The beacon exceeds the 2 KiB body cap.

429.description: Per-client flood budget exhausted; the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

post.description: Register (or re-register) the calling install's wake address; re-registration replaces the stored row so FCM token churn never strands a device.

404.description: No push transport is configured — a shell must not believe registration succeeded.

422.description: Bad device id or token shape, an unconfigured transport, or the per-extension device list is full (8; deregister one first).

429.description: Per-client write flood budget exhausted (shares the contacts budget); the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

get.description: The session extension's registered push devices, newest first. The wake address is write-only and never echoed.

404.description: No push transport is configured — a shell reads that as "this server cannot ring closed apps".

delete.description: Deregister the calling install (logout). An unknown or foreign id is the same 204 — the deregistration outcome is identical.

204.description: No response body. Deregistered (unknown and foreign ids included).

404.description: No push transport is configured — the surface does not exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The shell-minted device id to deregister.

post.description: Verify the credentials against the PBX directory and mint the tab session (sets the HttpOnly cookie, rotates CSRF).

201.description: Session created. Credential brokering on answers the session-derived REGISTER credential instead of the password; no-store keeps either credential out of caches.

401.description: Credentials rejected by the PBX directory.

429.description: Per-client login flood budget exhausted; the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

get.description: Island boot probe: a live cookie gets the SIP credentials back so the browser re-registers without the login form. no-store.

200.description: The cookie's live session. Exactly one credential field rides: sip_credential (session-derived, credential brokering on) or password (legacy wire).

401.description: No live session — the island shows the login form.

delete.description: Sign the tab session out: clears the session cookie and rotates CSRF. Idempotent — 204 whether or not a live session existed.

204.description: No response body. Session destroyed (any live session deleted, cookies cleared).

post.description: Re-mint the session for another extension mapped to the signed-in user (mapped logins only): directory-verifies the target line, rotates CSRF, deletes the old session row. The client reloads; the boot probe re-registers.

200.description: The re-minted session's identity (same login email, new extension). Switching to the session's own extension is an idempotent no-op answer without a mint.

401.description: No live session, or the PBX directory rejected the target line's credentials.

403.description: CSRF token missing or invalid, an unmapped login, or an extension not mapped to this account.

429.description: Line-switch budget exhausted; the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

503.description: The target line's password file could not be sourced (secrets pipeline).

post.description: Transcribe one audio segment via the configured ASR provider (live calls, voicemail, MMS audio all ride this endpoint). The request body is the raw audio bytes as a multipart/form-data part (honest Content-Type, up to 25 MiB); filename and lang ride the query string. Session-gated and CSRF-protected like every JSON post.

400.description: The audio could not be read, or the segment was empty.

404.description: The ASR seam is not configured on this server — the surface does not exist.

429.description: Per-client flood budget exhausted; the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

502.description: The transcription provider failed (including rejected upstream credentials — never a client problem).

503.description: The transcription concurrency ceiling is busy — retry shortly.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Original filename hint for the provider (optional).

post.description: Persist one live-call transcript segment to the owner-scoped store behind the History tab's transcript section. Fire-and-forget: 204 whether stored or deliberately shaped.

204.description: No response body. Stored (or deliberately shaped — the island's capture loop never retries).

400.description: Malformed segment (bad direction, missing callId/startedAt/remote/text, oversized body).

404.description: The ASR seam is not configured — the surface does not exist.

413.description: The segment text exceeds the 4000-character bound.

429.description: Per-client flood budget exhausted; the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

delete.description: Erase one call's transcript (the end-user leg of the retention story). Idempotent: an unknown or already-deleted call is the same 204.

204.description: No response body. Erased (or already absent).

400.description: The call query parameter is missing or oversized.

404.description: The ASR seam is not configured — the surface does not exist.

429.description: Per-client flood budget exhausted; the answer carries a Retry-After header naming the seconds until the bucket refills.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the flood bucket refills (see the response description).

parameters.name: call
parameters.description: The call id whose transcript to erase.

override.description: True on the click-through: spend this remote's one-shot override.

remote.description: The sanitized dialable remote the island is about to invite.

allowed.description: True when the dial may proceed (the attempt is recorded).

last_at.description: Unix seconds of the slot's last allowed dial (denied asks only).

window.description: The configured cooldown window in seconds (denied asks only; powers the remaining-wait phrasing).

disposition.description: The operator's verdict: answered|voicemail|ivr|missed|failed|unknown. Only a human may claim answered.

number.description: The remote number (verbatim) the CRM contact resolves against.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds; negative values are clamped to 0.

disposition.description: How the call ended: answered|missed|voicemail|ivr|failed|unknown. The island reports only what it observed: missed (never connected) or unknown (media flowed; human vs voicemail is undetermined). answered arrives only via an operator confirm.

key.description: Island-generated idempotency key (UUID, max 128 chars). A retry with the same key answers 204 without journaling again; a failed (502) attempt stays retryable. Absent or empty means no dedupe.

number.description: The remote number the call was made with, e.g. +4917012345678.

outcome.description: Legacy island field, demoted via the legacy table (answered→unknown); superseded by disposition.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds; negative values are clamped to 0.

body.description: The note's plain text (max 4000 chars); empty clears the note.

dispatched.description: True when the review job was accepted.

duplicate.description: True when this call already has a review (done or in flight).
True when this call was already summarized in the idempotency window.

id.description: The draft's review id (empty when duplicate).

text.description: The drafted follow-up text (empty when duplicate).

bytes.description: The segment's audio size in bytes (ASR beacons only).

interval.description: The measured interval: dial_to_audio (dial-press to first remote audio) or asr_round_trip (spoken segment to text on screen).

legs_ms.description: The interval's named legs in milliseconds (server-fixed vocabulary, e.g. island_overhead/signaling/media_attach/audio_gap for dial_to_audio).

device_id.description: The shell-minted per-install id (8-64 chars of letters, digits, hyphens, underscores).

token.description: The device's wake address: an ntfy topic or an FCM registration token. Write-only — never echoed back.

transport.description: The wake wire to register: ntfy or fcm (must be configured on the server).

extension.description: The PBX extension to sign in, e.g. 1001.

agent_default_mode.description: The configured draft mode a reset restores.

agent_mode.description: The textagent's effective draft mode (agent seam on only; empty hides the nav pill).

agent_mode_source.description: Where the draft mode comes from: config or a runtime pin.

agent_modes.description: The draft modes the agent supports, in cycle order.

did.description: Presented PSTN number (config identities), when known.

display_name.description: The passkey user's display name, when the extension is passkey-mapped.

extensions.description: Every extension mapped to the signed-in user (mapped logins only); more than one renders the line switcher.

numbers.description: Every number mapped to the passkey user, deduplicated.

cookieAuth.name: webphone_session
cookieAuth.description: The tab session cookie minted by POST /api/session; every session-gated surface requires it.

tags.name: webphone machine API
tags.description: Session-gated JSON API behind the webphone UI: sessions, CSRF, personal contacts, and the CRM call journal. Credentials are verified against the PBX directory before a session is minted.
